title: WorldCore: Core Loop
summary: Read the region, respect hazards, adjust the route, and log what changed.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Enter region, read hazards, prepare counters, complete a focused objective, and update your map or base notes before pushing further.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each crossing, note which biome, hazard, structure, or warning changed your plan. The region is teaching you how to travel it.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop when the region starts demanding gear you did not bring. Mark the boundary and return prepared.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
